title: On the monomials of Poincaré Series of negative index
summary: It is well known that an Eisenstein series $E_k$ cannot be written as a product of two lower-weight Eisenstein series, except for $E_{14}=E_4 E_{10}= E_4^2 E_6= E_6 E_8$. A similar result is also known for the Hecke eigenforms. It is also known that equalities among the monomials of the Eisenstein series can be reduced to the above-mentioned identities. Recently, the present author, along with E. Saha studied the possible monomial relations of the Poincaré cusp forms of index $1$.
